svg.title: Role Battle Day 04 authoritative damage boundary mind map
svg.desc: A manually authored detailed mind map showing all damage producers entering a shared authority boundary, attribution serialization, double validation, periodic revalidation, rejection guards, and test evidence.
svg.text: Day 04 — route every damage path through authority
2026-08-10 | producer inventory → shared request boundary → serialized attribution → execution recheck → Health
ONE AUTHORITATIVE DAMAGE PIPELINE
Every producer requests damage; none grants itself permission.
Rules run before the spec and again before IncomingDamage.
DAY 04 COMPLETE
STARTING RISK: DISTRIBUTED AUTHORITY
Some producers could bypass relationship policy
Projectile and melee paths prefiltered locally
Graph direct, beam, radial, and hitscan paths varied
Shared ApplyDamageEffect did not enforce permission
Risk: client, friendly, protected, dead, or unattributed damage
could reach Health through an indirect route.
ENUMERABLE PRODUCER INVENTORY
No “all paths” claim without a checked list
Native CauseDamage • projectile • FireBall
FireBolt • FireGun • Enemy melee
Apply/Cause graph nodes • beam • hitscan • shards
Blueprint snapshots and test-only producers classified
The Markdown report and compile-time table must agree.
ATTRIBUTION CONTRACT
The effect context explains who caused damage
Ability tag • damage type • source role ID
Source controller and PlayerState
Future battle zone and battle event IDs
Duplicate and NetSerialize preserve optional fields
Existing base context holds instigator, causer, source object,
actors, and hit result; identities are re-resolved live.
REQUEST BOUNDARY
ApplyDamageEffect validates before spec creation
Resolve source and target avatars from ASCs
Require server authority and valid ownership/profile
Call AuraCombatRules::CanDamage using trusted context
Rejected request returns an empty result, creates no spec,
and never dereferences a missing ASC or avatar.
SECOND SERVER CHECK
Execution revalidates current truth
ExecCalc_Damage rechecks identity, state, and rules
Only accepted output becomes IncomingDamage
AttributeSet preserves one fatal state transition
Periodic ticks recheck protection and life state
A valid request cannot become stale permission later.
GUARDS AND VALIDATION
Invalid damage leaves authoritative
Health unchanged
✓ 10/10 Day 04 native tests
✓ Context serialization and all-producer attribution
✓ Preserved block/critical/resistance/knockback/debuff
✓ Listen and Dedicated client-forgery rejection
✓ Request sent → received → rejected → no Health delta
2026-08-13: all 35 Aura tests exited 0, including Day 04.
Protected behavior and future extension
Accepted damage still preserves critical, block, resistance, radial falloff, knockback, debuff, and hit-react semantics. Day 12 may populate trusted battle IDs,
but it must enter through the same boundary. Every new producer must update the inventory and compile-time table.
NON-BYPASS RULE
Prefiltering never replaces validation
Every producer → trusted parameters → boundary check → serialized context → execution recheck → authoritative Health
